_about: Department budget seeds for the Payment service (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Budget Concurrency, INV-1014). Loaded once at Payment's create_app() startup via BudgetRepository.ensure_seeded() per department - never overwrites an in-progress (already-seeded) budget on restart. Deliberately a separate file from tests/fixtures/sample-invoices.json's `budgets` block (that file is test data; this is runtime policy configuration - CLAUDE.md: never hardcode policy values) even though the values currently match.
